estimate.logical_qubits: ~20 (16 boundary sites + ~4 workspace; vs ~12 for the 8x8 TFIM datapoint, ratio ~1.7x)

estimate.stateprep_adiabatic_route: polynomial in N: heuristic T~1/gap=N -> ~0.6x volume; rigorous T~1/gap^2=N^2 (non-Clifford ~N^3) -> ~9.4x volume. Polynomial, so does NOT trigger the super-polynomial REFUTE clause.
estimate.measurement: energy-difference force = ~64 Clifford-measurable Pauli strings, zero non-Clifford (the non-Clifford cost is all in state-prep, as intended).
estimate.physical_qubits: high-rate STAR single register ~3,700-4,550 (sourced 2,240 scaled by Lq ratio 20/12 + factory); transversal baseline ~9,000-11,000.

analog_vs_digital: Analog FT neutral-atom MERA (HYP-016, ~75-1,500 atoms after the 25x drop) is ~3-50x CHEAPER in qubit count than digital high-rate STAR for the SAME static force, and equally R1-immune (hologron decay only kills the DYNAMIC analog measurement that shelved HYP-017). BUT the analog estimate is far less mature (no isometry->qLDPC mapping). Cheaper: analog. More defensible: digital STAR.
verdict_detail: SUPPORTED specifically on the high-rate-STAR + MERA-prep combination: clears all three pre-registered ceilings (logical volume ~0.03x, physical qubits ~4.5k < 5k, prep log-depth). The PHYSICAL-QUBIT figure (~4.5k) is the ROBUST part -- anchored to the sourced 2,240 scaled by the logical-qubit ratio, independent of the unknown T-count. CONDITIONALITY (kept LOW, not raised to medium): (1) the LOGICAL-VOLUME ratio rests on an INFERRED 8x8 reference volume (~87,600) because PAPER-120 does NOT publish the T-count or logical depth -- it is directionally safe ONLY because the MERA route is ~30x under the ceiling, a margin large enough to absorb a wrong denominator; (2) the verdict depends on MERA/log-depth prep -- the adiabatic route alone reaches ~9.4x volume at the rigorous N^3 bound, borderline-REFUTE; (3) the transversal-vs-high-rate gate-model gap is the pre-registered INCONCLUSIVE driver but is bounded (<25k). HONEST NET: the force is hardware-reachable in principle within the current FT roadmap (the meaningful answer), but the tight quantitative ratio needs appendix-level T-count extraction from 2606.25011 / 2509.18294 to harden beyond 'directionally SUPPORTED'.
